meaning.en: The newest release in the list

help.en: Installs Erlang/OTP from the prebuilt build of this Ubuntu release, instead of compiling it, and lists the prebuilt builds. Empty compiles from the source.
help.zh: 用这个 Ubuntu 版本的预编译构建安装 Erlang/OTP，而不是编译源码，版本列表也改为预编译构建。留空则从源码编译。

guide.en: Write the release as the list shows it, such as 29.1.2. With a prebuilt build selected, OTP-29.1.2 also installs the prebuilt build of that release.
guide.zh: 按列表中的样子写版本，如 29.1.2。选择了预编译构建后，OTP-29.1.2 也会安装该发行版的预编译构建。

tips.en: Source builds take a long time.
tips.zh: 源码编译需要很长时间。

tips.en: Set OTP_CONFIGURE_ARGS and MAKEFLAGS in Settings.
tips.zh: 在“设置”中设置 OTP_CONFIGURE_ARGS 与 MAKEFLAGS。

tips.en: Turn the search cache off first.
tips.zh: 先关闭搜索缓存，再使用预编译构建。

tips.en: Source builds refuse some characters in VFOX_HOME.
tips.zh: 源码编译会拒绝 VFOX_HOME 中的某些字符。

tips.en: Run a prebuilt install as erlang@29.1.2.
tips.zh: 预编译安装请用 erlang@29.1.2 运行。

tips.en: vfox exec does not map OTP- names.
tips.zh: vfox exec 不会映射 OTP- 名称。
